title: Square a crooked cabinet door: turn its top cup hinge's side screw with a screwdriver until the gap is even
instruction: The left door hangs crooked. Use the screwdriver on its hinge to even the gap between the doors, 2 to 3 mm, then shut the door and let go.
context: About 670,000 carpenters (47-2031) and 1.53 million general maintenance and repair workers (49-9071) work in the US (BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025) and adjust cup-hinged cabinet doors after every install and whenever a door drops out of line (O*NET 47-2031.01 Core: install 'hardware, using carpenters' hand or power tools'; 49-9071.00 Core: 'Adjust functional parts of devices or control instruments, using hand tools'). On a Blum CLIP top hinge the front screw on the hinge arm moves the door sideways at that hinge, so turning the top hinge's screw swings the door's top edge and squares the gap. The screw is reached only with the door open, and the gap shows only with the door shut, so the fitter opens the door, seats the screwdriver in the screw, turns it, shuts the door and looks.
setup: Frame: x forward from the line through the arm bases, y left from the midline, z up from the table top, mm. Two frameless cabinet boxes (18 mm white melamine board, each 300 wide x 300 deep x 450 high on a 30 mm plinth) stand side by side right of the middle, fixed to the table, fronts at x 400, joined at y -250, open sides toward the robot. Each has a 19 mm full-overlay door, 298 x 448 mm, 1.9 kg, with a 12 mm bar pull (120 mm long, 30 mm off the face) 30 mm from its free edge, hung on two Blum CLIP top 110-degree full-overlay hinges (71T3550) 80 mm from its top and bottom, on 0 mm mounting plates (173H7100). Both doors are right-hinged, as in a run of single-door cabinets (IKEA METOD doors mount to open either way): the right door on the right cabinet's outer side panel, the left door on the middle partition (the left cabinet's right side panel), so it opens toward the middle. The right door is square, 2.5 mm from the left door. The left door starts shut, crooked: the gap between the doors is 1.7 mm at 20 mm below the top and 2.6 mm at 20 mm above the bottom. Each hinge arm has a side-adjust screw (32 mm behind the cabinet front, 9 mm head with a PH2 cross recess 4 mm across and 1.5 mm deep; the left door's heads face into the left cabinet at y -210) and a depth screw (60 mm behind the front). A long-reach PH2 screwdriver (Wera 350 PH, 05008730001: 300 mm blade, 6 mm shaft; 100 mm red octagonal handle, 31 mm across the corners; 0.15 kg) lies on the cabinets' top, 10 degrees off the y axis: its tip at (482, -288), its handle out over the left cabinet's left side by 55 mm.
scoring: In simulation, a side screw turns only while the screwdriver's PH2 point is seated in its recess (within 1.5 mm of the centre), the driver within 15 degrees of the screw's axis and pushed in at least 10 N; 0.3 N m resists the turn. In a real trial the screw turns only by the robot's own seat, push and twist; the paint mark and feeler-gauge readings show the result. Shut: the left door within 2 degrees of closed. Gaps: the reveal between the two doors 20 mm below the top and 20 mm above the bottom. Released: every part of both grippers (fingers, pads, palm, housing) at least 30 mm from the cabinets, doors and screwdriver, the screwdriver's tip at least 20 mm from every screw, door and screwdriver still, for 1 s. 1.0: at the end, shut, released, both gaps 2.0 to 3.0 mm and within 0.5 mm of each other. 0.5: at the end, shut with those gaps, but not released. 0.25: at the end, the top hinge's side screw turned at least a quarter turn the right way (opening the gap at the top). Gate, any time, 0: a side screw forced half a turn past the end of its +-2 mm travel (the thread strips). Real trial: a feeler-gauge set in 0.1 mm steps at the two marked heights (read the thickest blade that slides in); evenness is the difference of the two readings; a paint mark on the screw head for the turn; the video for the release.
fidelity: One rigid door pivot on the 110-degree hinge swing (held open above 25 degrees, spring-shut below). Force-gated screw rule: the head turns with the driver's roll only with the PH2 point in the 4 mm, 1.5 mm-deep recess within 1.5 mm of centre, driver within 15 degrees of the axis, push at least 10 N. 0.3 N m resist (estimate); 1 mm travel per turn (assumed). Demo grip 35 N per finger, push aims for 13 N (about 12 N reached). Push and resist are simulation-only.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (one valid session, seed 1, 2,400 steps; the screw was never turned); demo: 1.0 (step 1508, 75.4 s).
